personality_one_liner: An elegant, magazine-like journey through India's rich heritage, blending immersive exploration with respectful, storytelling-led design.

spacing.rule: Magazine-like spacing rhythms with generous vertical breathing room. Let typography, whitespace, content, and imagery carry the personality. No dense card-heavy layouts.

dont's: No glassmorphism. Editorial personality relies on solid surfaces, fine borders, and generous whitespace instead of digital blur.

screens.purpose: Discover nearby heritage sites and curated Indian destinations.

states.loading: Skeleton images with subtle pulse, text lines as grey blocks.

screens.layout: Header with 'Yatra' in large display serif. Top section: 'Nearby' with a horizontal scroll of full-bleed image cards. instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality. Use Cormorant Garamond for headers and DM Sans for body text.
Do NOT use glassmorphism. Rely on solid surfaceSecondary and thin borders (#E5DED5) to create elevation and structure.
Use generous whitespace. Avoid cramped, card-heavy layouts. Let the beautiful imagery and elegant typography breathe.
For images with overlaid text (e.g., Place Detail hero, Home cards), you MUST use a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to ensure readable text.
The audio player should be a sticky bottom element (solid background, top border) on the Place Detail screen, not a glass pane.
AR Camera View can be mocked with an immersive image background and floating informational UI cards.
Ensure all primary CTAs are sticky at the bottom with proper safe-area padding.
Deep Indigo is used for text to provide high contrast without defaulting to pure black, maintaining the heritage warmth.
